description:
`find_block_pivot_invert` and `eliminate_block_full` in `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/gauss.rs` duplicate helpers of `alg/rref.rs`.

## Background

The comment that justified the duplicate stated that `rref::eliminate_block` clears only rows below the pivot stripe; it clears all rows, and the sweep removed the comment. `@/inv/convention-convergence` applies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The inversion path uses the shared rref helpers, or a cited, tracked exception records why it cannot.
- [hard] REQ-02: Inversion results are unchanged on the existing suite.
title: alg/gauss.rs duplicates the rref block-pivot and elimination helpers
